from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 38.4
length = 58.7
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
shoulder_length = 21.3
inner_diameter = 25.4

main_body = Pos(length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(outer_diameter/2, length)
shoulder = Pos(length + shoulder_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(shoulder_diameter/2, shoulder_length)
combined = main_body + shoulder

inner_bore = Pos((length + shoulder_length)/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_diameter/2, length + shoulder_length)
result = combined - inner_bore

part = result
part.name = "stepped_cylinder_with_bore"
export_step(part, "output.step")

        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

inner_cut = p2.part
solid_body = solid_body - inner_cut

part = solid_body
part.name = "curved_frame"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

base_diameter = 80.0
base_height = 26.0
hex_across_flats = 60.0
top_height = 32.0

base = Pos(0, 0, base_height/2) * Cylinder(base_diameter/2, base_height)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_height)) as s:
        RegularPolygon(hex_across_flats/2, 6)
    extrude(amount=top_height)
hex_top = p.part

part = base + hex_top
part.name = "base_with_hex_top"
export_step(part, "output.step")
